description: Fine-grained document-level ablations for v7 graph relation modeling. Runtime masks keep graph tensors immutable.

experiments.name: M00_full_ce_ohem
experiments.hypothesis: Full v7 multimodal graph model is the strongest metric and visual-QA baseline.
experiments.purpose: Full features + GATv2 + directional deep head + CE/OHEM.

experiments.name: M01_no_message_passing
experiments.hypothesis: If GAT message passing matters, removing it should hurt PARENT_CHILD and ambiguous MERGE.
experiments.purpose: Project nodes and classify edges with no graph convolution.

experiments.name: M02_no_symmetry_terms
experiments.hypothesis: Directional symmetry-breaking terms Hu-Hv and Hu*Hv are important for directed PARENT_CHILD.

experiments.name: M03_shallow_predictor
experiments.hypothesis: Rare MERGE needs the deep edge head; a shallow head should underfit boundary subtleties.
experiments.purpose: Keep GATv2 but reduce predictor to one hidden layer.

experiments.name: F00_no_scibert
experiments.hypothesis: Layout alone is not enough for paragraph continuation and semantic parent-child ambiguity.

experiments.name: F01_semantic_only
experiments.hypothesis: Text semantics alone cannot solve two-column reading order or visual hierarchy.
experiments.purpose: Keep SciBERT, zero all non-semantic node features.

experiments.name: F02_no_geometry
experiments.hypothesis: Absolute/local geometry still contributes after v7 flow features exist.
experiments.purpose: Remove anchor geometry and scroll geometry.

experiments.name: F03_no_reading_flow
experiments.hypothesis: v7 band/column/flow features are the main protection against reading-order inversion.
experiments.purpose: Remove scroll-y, sequence, column, layout-layer, flow-context and matching edge flow cues.

experiments.name: F04_no_style_title
experiments.hypothesis: Font/style/title probes carry heading-level and parent-child signal that pure geometry misses.
experiments.purpose: Remove PyMuPDF style stats, title probes, and typography deltas.

experiments.name: E00_no_edge_semantic
experiments.hypothesis: Semantic cosine specifically helps MERGE but should be less important for visual parent-child.

experiments.name: E01_no_punctuation
experiments.hypothesis: Terminal punctuation and hyphen probes are a high-precision MERGE boundary signal.
experiments.purpose: Remove source terminal punctuation and hyphen features.

experiments.name: E02_no_gutter_overlap
experiments.hypothesis: Gutter/overlap features suppress cross-column false MERGE.

experiments.name: E03_no_index_bins
experiments.hypothesis: Binned sequence distance helps without becoming a brittle direct shortcut.

experiments.name: T00_no_ohem
experiments.hypothesis: Without OHEM, the long-tail NONE distribution washes out MERGE/PARENT_CHILD.
experiments.purpose: Full model, plain CE, no OHEM.

experiments.name: T01_random_none_dropout
experiments.hypothesis: Random NONE dropout raises recall but damages precision because it discards hard negatives.
experiments.purpose: Full model with random training-only NONE edge dropout.

experiments.name: T02_focal_inverse
experiments.hypothesis: Focal/inverse weights should improve minority recall but may over-predict MERGE.
experiments.purpose: Full model with focal loss and inverse class weights.

experiments.name: T03_weighted_ce
experiments.hypothesis: Hand-weighted CE may provide a middle ground between OHEM and focal over-recall.
experiments.purpose: Full model with custom class weights but no OHEM.
